=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.py:74-76 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_value_class()` (`return "on" if value == "true" else "off"`) treats only the literal `true` as on. Some switches count other values as on: `E2E_PHASE4B_QUEUED_GRACE_ENABLED` accepts `1|true|yes|on`, several workflows test `!= 'false'`, and `CLAUDE_POOL_CAPACITY_WAIT_ENABLED` treats an empty string as on.
  WHY: A stage that is actually running gets `value_class=off`, so `STAGE_SWITCH_OFF ... status=alert` is logged and a false Telegram WARNING goes out every day, which teaches owners to ignore the watch (defeats G2). Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT (it says operators mostly set `true`/`false`); gemini, minimax, luna and glm rated it MAJOR. The highest was used.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:183-198 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `stage_switch_report()` writes the day marker and emits `alerted=true` whenever `attempted > 0`, even when every `tg_send_msg` failed (`delivered=0`, `alert_state=not_delivered`). The "Record today's stage switch alert" step (.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:464-472) then saves the cache key anyway.
  WHY: After a transient Telegram or network failure, later runs that UTC day report `alert=already_sent_today` and never retry, so the alert slips by up to a full day. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT; the other four rated it MAJOR. The highest was used.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:158-162 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: One daily cache key (`stage-switch-off-alert-<day>`, .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:447/471) plus the `STAGE_SWITCH_ALERTED_TODAY` short-circuit apply to the whole watch, not to each switch. minimax raised this inside its combined entry at scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh lines 187-198.
  WHY: A switch that passes its wait time after another switch has already alerted that day (Monday 09:00 retro run, or a dispatch) is suppressed as `already_sent_today`. Its first alert slips by about 21-23h, which breaks G2's one alert per switch. Severity disagreement: sonnet and glm rated it NIT (confidence 3); gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR. The highest was used.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:83-85, 437-472 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The day-marker cache key and the concurrency group (keyed by `github.ref_name`) give no deduplication across refs. minimax, luna and glm say Actions caches are ref-scoped, so runs on different refs each miss the marker. gemini describes the opposite mechanism: the key is not scoped by ref and is shared across branches.
  WHY: Runs on different refs on the same UTC day can each send the same alerts (or, per gemini, suppress each other), which breaks the at-most-once-per-day guarantee. Severity disagreement: glm rated it NIT (confidence 3) and notes that schedule and retro runs share the default branch; gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR. The highest was used.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:428-473 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Every watch step has `if: always() && (vars.STAGE_SWITCH_WATCH_ENABLED || 'true') == 'true'`, so when the watch is disabled `stage_switch_read()` never runs. The contractual `STAGE_SWITCH_WATCH outcome=disabled` line (README.md:176, agents.d/9994-stage-switch-watch.md) is therefore never printed in a real run.
  WHY: Someone reading the logs cannot tell "watch switched off" from "steps missing or never ran"; the documented disabled path only runs in tests. All four rated it NIT.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:80-106 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On a failed `gh api` listing, `stage_switch_read()` deletes the captured stderr (`listing.err`) without showing it, and the warning always blames token scope ("GH_PAT needs repo scope or Variables: read"). Reviewers cited different line ranges for this branch: 80-83, 83-85, 100-105 and 100-106.
  WHY: A rate limit (403), a 5xx or a network failure looks the same as a permission problem (`reason=gh_api rc=1`), which misleads the operator. All five rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G1 "Start with the switches documented in the README variable tables whose default is `true`" (tables, plural); G5 "so a new switch cannot be added without being covered."
  expected_change_site: scripts/stage_switches.json (switches list) and tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py (`_readme_variables_rows`, `SWITCH_DEFAULT_RE`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Default-`true` rows in the README "## Required Variables" table (line 2730+) are missing from scripts/stage_switches.json: `LESSONS_LEARNED_ENABLED` (README.md:2818), `HEAL_PLAN_GRANT_BODY_EDIT_FIX_ENABLED` (README.md:3051; read in plan.yml:2162/3342, clarify.yml:1521 and implement.yml:2455 via `vars.HEAL_PLAN_GRANT_BODY_EDIT_FIX_ENABLED || ''`) and `WORKFLOW_HEAL_SCOPE_MARKER_GUARD_ENABLED` (README.md:3059). `_readme_variables_rows()` (tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py:62-74 / 68-86) reads only the first `#### Variables` table and stops at the next heading (`#### Stage switch watch`, README.md:545). `SWITCH_DEFAULT_RE` matches only `|| 'true'`, not `|| ''`, `!= 'false'` or the script-side `${X:-true}` form (scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:199, scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:303). As a result `test_every_readme_true_switch_is_in_registry` and `test_every_workflow_true_switch_is_in_registry` pass while these switches go unwatched. glm notes that `WORKFLOW_HEAL_SCOPE_MARKER_GUARD_ENABLED` is script-env-only and may only need an explicit non-goal note.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.py:`_value_class()` `return "on" if value == "true" else "off"` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Only the literal `true` counts as on, but these workflows keep the stage on for any value other than `false`: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:598` and `:611` (`vars.RETARGET_MERGED_BASE_ENABLED != 'false'`), `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:177` (PROVIDER_OUTAGE_RESUME_ENABLED), `.github/workflows/internal-cancel-on-pr-close.yml:26` (WORKFLOW_HEAL_PR_RECONCILE_ENABLED) and `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1413` (CHATGPT_POOL_HEALTH_ALERT_ENABLED). The E2E_PHASE4B_QUEUED_GRACE_ENABLED stage text also says 1/true/yes/on.
  WHY: Values such as `1`, `yes`, `on` or `enabled` give `value_class=off`, which produces a false daily WARNING. The only way to silence it is an `off_on_purpose` marker that records the opposite of the truth. The trigger is uncommon.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:`stage_switch_report()` marker block; `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:464-471` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The day marker and `alerted=true` are written whenever a send was attempted, including `alert_state=not_delivered` (`scripts/tg_helpers.sh:147-160` returns an empty id on failure).
  WHY: The cache key is saved even though nothing was delivered, so a later run the same day logs `alert=already_sent_today` and the alert is lost until the next day's 06:00 run.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh / .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml lines 447 and 471 (single cache key; `STAGE_SWITCH_ALERTED_TODAY`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The once-per-day limit applies to the whole watch, not to each switch.
  WHY: A switch that passes its wait time before the Monday 09:00 retro run is skipped as `already_sent_today`, about 21h later than G2 allows.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml lines 430, 441, 452 and 465 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `if:` on every step skips them when the variable is not `true`, so the documented `outcome=disabled` line (README, agents.d/9994-stage-switch-watch.md) is never printed.
  WHY: A disabled watch cannot be told apart from steps that never ran. A fix would also need `test_watch_steps_are_wired_in_collect_logs` updated.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:`stage_switch_read()` `rm -f "${listing}" "${stage_switch_dir}/listing.err"` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: gh's stderr is deleted without being shown, and the warning always blames token scope.
  WHY: A 403 rate limit, a 5xx or a network failure all show the same `reason=gh_api rc=1` with a possibly wrong scope hint.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Requirement: G1 "Start with the switches documented in the README variable tables whose default is `true`"; G5 "so a new switch cannot be added without being covered."
  Expected change site: scripts/stage_switches.json and tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py (`_readme_variables_rows` and `SWITCH_DEFAULT_RE`)
  Evidence of absence: README "## Required Variables" (line 2730 onward) lists `HEAL_PLAN_GRANT_BODY_EDIT_FIX_ENABLED` (line 3051), `WORKFLOW_HEAL_SCOPE_MARKER_GUARD_ENABLED` (line 3059) and `LESSONS_LEARNED_ENABLED` (line 2818), none of which are in the registry. HEAL_PLAN_GRANT_BODY_EDIT_FIX_ENABLED is read in plan.yml:2162 and 3342, clarify.yml:1521 and implement.yml:2455. `_readme_variables_rows()` stops at `#### Stage switch watch` (line 545). `SWITCH_DEFAULT_RE` misses the `|| ''` and `!= 'false'` forms.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (4 related items): gate the marker on `delivered -gt 0`; print a sanitized first line of `listing.err`; treat `1`/`yes`/`on` as on in `_value_class()`; add a `!= 'false'` regex and scan "## Required Variables" in tests. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
- Note (not reported): cross-ref de-duplication gap judged too unlikely to report.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.py:74-76 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_value_class` classifies every value other than the literal "true" as off.
  WHY: Variables documented as on for "1", "yes" or "on" are marked off, which produces false daily Telegram WARNINGs.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:160-162 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The daily alert marker applies to the whole watch run rather than to each switch.
  WHY: Switches that become eligible later the same day are suppressed, which breaks the per-switch alert requirement.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:183-197 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `alerted=true` and the day marker are written even when every send failed (`alert_state=not_delivered`).
  WHY: A transient network error blocks retries for the rest of the UTC day (`alert=already_sent_today`).
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:447 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The cache key `stage-switch-off-alert-${{ steps.stage_switch_read.outputs.day }}` is not scoped by ref or branch name.
  WHY: Concurrent runs on different branches share the daily key, so one run can suppress another run's alerts, or duplicate alerts can go out.
- scripts/stage_switch_watch.sh:83-85 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `listing.err` is deleted without showing its stderr on failure.
  WHY: 403, 5xx and network errors all produce the same generic warning.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | c
